args.body: Hi Eve! I just visited your blog at www.eve-blog.com and wanted to share some feedback. I love that you highlight your favorite hobby, hiking — it gives the blog a personal touch right away. A few suggestions: consider adding more posts about your hiking adventures, maybe with photos or trail recommendations, to give visitors more to explore. Also, a short "About Me" section could help readers connect with you better. Overall, a nice start — keep it up!

Hi Dora! I just visited your personal website at www.dora-website.com and wanted to share some feedback. It's great that you have a personal site and that you make your contact email easy to find. A few suggestions to make it even better: consider adding more content about yourself — who you are, what you do, and what visitors can find on your site. Some sections like "About Me," your projects or interests, and maybe a portfolio or blog would make the site more engaging. Also, a bit of visual design and structure could help it stand out. Overall, a solid start — keep building on it!
